ASI, Bradley, Metpar, General Partitions, Ammco locators: not tried after the JS and 404 results above.

BBB (prod.bbb.org Section 10 Inc, Midlothian VA): 403 blocked
BuildingConnected and Procore: not tried (search cap)

WebSearch: all 8 used. Queries: toilet partition installation VB, Norfolk and Chesapeake; Division 10 Hampton Roads; restroom partitions installer VA and Richmond; toilet partitions in Norfolk, Chesapeake, Newport News and Suffolk; Frank M. Waters; VA partitions, lockers and installation specialties; Richmond Division 10 specialties; Hampton Roads toilet partitions. Few local results.

Excluded after reading: GC Specialties (Mobile, AL, no VA mention), Construction Specialties Installations (NY, NH and FL, no VA mention), Seven Oaks Doors & Hardware (Locust, NC; serves South Central VA, out of range), Partition Pros (national, no local crew), H2I Group (Eagan, MN, no partitions), Allegheny Construction Specialties (Nashville), Complete Interior Package (North Chesterfield; no partitions listed), Martin Bros (California).

Leads not verified (blocked or no site found): Section 10 Inc (Midlothian, VA, per a BBB search snippet that lists bathroom partitions), Barranger Company (location unknown), Frank M. Waters Inc (Maryland, toilet partitions).

candidates.name: Virginia Storage Systems
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists toilet partitions and toilet accessories, says they sell and install, and describes installing 21 toilet stalls at a theme park; staff page says the VP oversees all installations.
candidates.reason: Chesapeake-based seller and installer of toilet partitions, lockers and accessories for commercial and industrial clients (rail yard, theme park, power plant) across Hampton Roads. It also sells partitions, so there is some buy-around risk.
red_flags: No general company email; only individual staff emails on site

license.name: Virginia Storage Systems
license.registry: Virginia DPOR License Lookup (Board for Contractors)
license.note: Virginia requires a Board for Contractors license above the dollar threshold. The DPOR lookup needs a reCAPTCHA, so automated lookup was not possible: check by hand. The company homepage (http://www.virginiastorage.com/) shows no license number. The Virginia Beach business license (license tax on gross receipts) was not checked online. Checked 2026-11-19.

candidates.name: Partition Plus
candidates.partition_evidence: About page says it offers regional installation in MD, DC, VA, PA and DE.

Based well over 120 miles from Virginia Beach
